info.name: Student 1 - Land Application Management
info.description:
Postman collection for Student 1 - Land Application Management APIs (LRMIS).

NOTE: Run seed_data.py before using this collection. Some requests change application status. For repeatable testing, reset the seed before rerunning transition/action requests.

request.description: Creates a new land application. Expected result: 201 Created with the new application ID and status 'submitted'. The Idempotency-Key header prevents duplicate submissions if the request is retried.

Lists applications filtered by status='submitted' with pagination (page 1, 10 per page). Expected result: 200 OK with a paginated list of submitted applications. Read-only — safe to run at any time without affecting application state.

Retrieves full details for application LRMIS-2026-0001. Expected result: 200 OK with the application object including current state, history, and document list. Read-only — safe to run at any time without affecting application state.

Moves LRMIS-2026-0001 from 'submitted' to 'pre_checked' — a valid step in the workflow. Expected result: 200 OK with updated application state. Prerequisite: LRMIS-2026-0001 must be in 'submitted' state (run seed_data.py to reset). This request mutates state, so running it twice will fail with a state conflict.

Attempts to jump LRMIS-2026-0002 directly from 'submitted' to 'approved', skipping required intermediate states. Expected result: 400 Bad Request or 422 Unprocessable Entity with an error message indicating the transition is not allowed. Uses a separate application ID from the Valid Transition request to avoid state pollution. Prerequisite: LRMIS-2026-0002 must be in 'submitted' state.

Places LRMIS-2026-0003 on hold pending external confirmation. Expected result: 200 OK with the application status updated to 'on_hold'. Uses a dedicated application ID separate from Reject and Missing Documents requests to prevent state conflicts. Prerequisite: LRMIS-2026-0003 must be in an active (non-terminal) state.

Rejects LRMIS-2026-0004 due to an invalid ownership document. Expected result: 200 OK with the application status updated to 'rejected'. Uses a dedicated application ID separate from Hold and Missing Documents requests. Prerequisite: LRMIS-2026-0004 must be in an active (non-terminal) state. This is a terminal action — the application cannot be transitioned further after rejection.

Flags LRMIS-2026-0005 as having missing documents and notifies the applicant. Expected result: 200 OK with the application status updated to reflect the document request (e.g., 'pending_documents'). Uses a dedicated application ID separate from Hold and Reject requests to prevent state conflicts. Prerequisite: LRMIS-2026-0005 must be in an active state.

Issues an ownership certificate for LRMIS-2026-0004. Expected result: 200 OK or 201 Created with the generated certificate details and application status updated to 'certificate_issued'. PREREQUISITE: LRMIS-2026-0004 must be in 'approved' state AND must not already have a certificate issued. If the application is not approved or a certificate already exists, the request will fail. Reset seed_data.py to restore this precondition.

Closes LRMIS-2026-0005 after the certificate has been issued. Expected result: 200 OK with the application status updated to 'closed'. Uses a separate application ID from Generate Certificate so both requests can be run independently. Prerequisite: LRMIS-2026-0005 must be in 'certificate_issued' state. This is a terminal action — the application cannot be transitioned further once closed.
